props.text:
Would be peak irony if the people who ignored the 4 year cycle at the top end up using it to call the bottom, only for it to stop working. Then again, it'd be just as ironic if I ignore it and we end up putting in the major low in Q4. 😅

Sooner or later, we're all gonna find out, fellas.

All that matters is you have exposure to $BTC at these levels 1-2 years from now.
Aligns with KillaXBT's documented HTF bullish thesis (bear cycle ~80% complete) and group structural bullish lean (bull_genius DCA, Bitcoin_Astro confluence validation).
